room_rent.note: Policyholder selects either 1% of SI per day or No Capping at inception. Proportionate deduction applies if room taken above selected limit.

icu.display: 2x selected Room Rent limit or No cap
icu.note: ICU = 2 times the Room Rent selected; if No Capping chosen for room, ICU also has no cap.

copayment.display: None (20% if aged 61–65 at first entry)
copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay applies only to insured persons aged 61+ at first policy issuance; applies on all subsequent renewals too.

sub_limits.display: Cataract 20% of SI max ₹1L/eye; LASIK per schedule; Modern Tx 50% SI max ₹5L; Bariatric 50% SI max ₹5L; GRS ₹1L lifetime
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 20% of SI subject to max ₹1L; LASIK: ₹30,000/₹50,000 for both eyes (Mini); Modern treatments: 50% SI max ₹5L; Bariatric: 50% SI max ₹5L after 36 months; Gender Reassignment Surgery: ₹1L lifetime; Screening & Vaccinations: ₹20,000 per policy period.

deductible.note: Voluntary deductible (₹10,000/₹25,000/₹50,000) available as optional add-on.

ped_waiting.note: Policy schedule specifies 1 or 2 year PED waiting period options. For portability/migration policies only 2-year option available.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Most named ailments (cataract, hernia, etc.) have 12 or 24 month wait per schedule choice; joint replacement/osteoporosis 36 months.

maternity.note: Maternity is an optional cover; Mini plan supports sub-limits A and B only (Normal ₹20k/₹30k; Caesarean ₹30k/₹50k); 36-month continuous coverage required; portability/migration not applicable.

cumulative_bonus.note: CB increases 25% per claim-free year up to 100% of SI; reduces at same rate if claim made. Optional Cumulative Bonus Booster (100%/yr up to 500%) available separately.

restoration.note: Triggered on second claim in same policy year (same or new illness); excludes maternity claims; Chemotherapy/Dialysis usable once in lifetime.

pre_hosp.note: Mini plan offers 30/60/90 days pre-hospitalisation cover as per chosen option in schedule.

post_hosp.note: Mini plan offers 60/90/120 days post-hospitalisation cover as per chosen option in schedule.

domiciliary.display: Not covered (base); Home Health Care optional
domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is specifically excluded (4.2.3). Home Health Care (up to 20% of SI) is an optional cover.

ayush.note: AYUSH/Alternative Treatment is an optional cover; covers inpatient AYUSH hospitalisation up to SI.

ambulance.note: Road Ambulance is an optional cover; Mini plan limits ₹1,000/₹1,500/₹2,000 per hospitalisation. No inbuilt ambulance cover.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered as inpatient or day care; capped at 50% of SI subject to max ₹5L per policy year.

consumables.display: Optional rider (up to 15% of admissible claim)
consumables.note: Non-Medical & Consumable Expenses Cover is an optional add-on; covers List-I items up to 15% of admissible claim amount.

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded (4.2.4); territorial limit is India only.

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary hospitalisation, OPD (except inbuilt OPD benefit), dental (unless injury), STDs other than HIV, external congenital anomaly, stem cell storage, treatment outside India
optional_riders: Maternity, Road Ambulance, Air Ambulance, Daily Hospital Cash, Convalescence Benefit, Accompanying Person, Accidental Death, Critical Illness Booster, Accident Booster, Non-Medical & Consumables, Home Health Care, AYUSH, Cumulative Bonus Booster, Voluntary Co-Pay, Voluntary Deductible
